## Abstract

In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated generations in Large Language Models. By analyzing the structural integrity and information dispersion across attention layers, we identify characteristic topological anomalies associated with context breakdown and factual inconsistency.
